title: Tactile 0.30 深度性能与体验跃升

notes.zh:
Tactile 0.30 重点更新：
• 原生 AppKit 打造全新交互式吸附与微小手势 HUD，彻底消除 NSHostingView 布局死循环与卡顿
• 硬件级触控防重启优化：底层恢复设备运行状态比对复用，彻底根除热插拔与重载时的触控硬件重置风暴
• 触控板多设备架构强化：精准区分 Magic Mouse 与 Trackpad 抬手帧，修复妙控鼠标双指轻点中键判定；补齐手掌防误触动态清空
• 绘字与手势数据竞争彻底消除：触控线程与主线程候选词更新加锁同步，双指间距容差自适应校准生效
• 消除 120Hz 触控看门狗调度风暴：采用极低开销标量时间戳看门狗定时器，CPU 占用大幅下降
• 1000Hz 高回报率电竞鼠标划动优化：新增 4px 最小步长滤波，消除高频 Task 调度与 CoreAnimation 绘制负载
• 睡眠唤醒防抖：合并高频唤醒信号，彻底杜绝短时间内并发 9+ 个重连任务导致的资源争抢
• 内存释放体系优化：MainActor 优雅清理 UI 缓冲区后再异步释放 Malloc Zone
• 截图涂鸦与设置图标绘制遵循现代 macOS 14+ 规范，全面采用线程安全 drawingHandler 绘制
notes.en:
Tactile 0.30 Highlights:
• Native AppKit interactive snap and micro-gesture HUD, completely eliminating NSHostingView layout loop jank
• Hardware-level multitouch reload optimization: restores device status reuse, preventing hotplug restart storms
• Multitouch multi-device architecture overhaul: preserves device kind on lift-off frames for Magic Mouse middle-click; resets PalmTracker state
• Resolved character drawing data race: thread-safe candidate updates with unfairLock; respects calibrated spacing & tap speed
• Eliminated 120Hz touch watchdog storm: single scalar-timestamp watchdog timer dramatically reduces idle/stream CPU usage
• High-polling mouse optimization: 4px step filter prevents 1000Hz gaming mice from flooding Tasks and CoreAnimation draws
• Sleep/wake reconnection debouncing: single-task sequence cancellation avoids redundant staggered reconnect storms
• Refined QoS memory sweep: cleans UI buffers on MainActor before deferred Darwin malloc zone pressure relief
• Modernized AppKit graphics contexts using thread-safe NSImage drawingHandler
